title: Extracting DNA from viruses embedded in agarose
author: Grieg F. Steward
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.dsd6a5

steps.title: Prepare agarose‑SE mixture
steps.instruction: Add agarose to SE buffer to obtain a final agarose concentration of 1.5 % (wt/vol).

steps.title: Melt and equilibrate agarose
steps.instruction: Melt the agarose mixture in a microwave oven, then cool it and hold at 37 °C in a water bath.

steps.title: Warm viral concentrate and embed in agarose
steps.instruction: Warm the viral concentrate to 37 °C, mix it 1:1 with the molten agarose, and cast the mixture into molds.

substeps.instruction: Warm viral concentrate to 37 °C in the water bath.
Mix an equal volume of viral concentrate with molten agarose.
Transfer the mixture quickly to casting molds (rectangular plug molds preferred for PFGE; alternatively use a 1‑cc syringe with tip cut off or pipette drops onto plastic wrap or Parafilm M).

steps.title: Gel solidification and transfer to lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Allow the agarose to gel, then move each plug into a tube containing 5 volumes of lysis buffer with proteinase K at a final concentration of 1 mg mL⁻¹.

substeps.instruction: Transfer each plug (or noodle/button) into a tube with 5 volumes lysis buffer amended with proteinase K (1 mg mL⁻¹ final).

steps.title: Lysis incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at room temperature for overnight (~18 h).

steps.title: Remove lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Decant the lysis buffer carefully without losing the plugs.

steps.title: Optional PMSF rinse (twice)
steps.instruction: Rinse the plugs twice with TE containing PMSF to inactivate proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Add 25 volumes of fresh TE containing 1 mM PMSF to each plug.
Incubate with gentle agitation for 1 h.
Repeat the entire procedure once more.

steps.title: First TE rinse (no PMSF)
steps.instruction: Rinse the plugs with TE lacking PMSF.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 volumes of fresh TE (no PMSF) to each plug.
Incubate with gentle agitation for 30 min.

steps.title: Second TE rinse (no PMSF)
steps.instruction: Repeat the TE rinse without PMSF.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 volumes of fresh TE (no PMSF) to each plug.
Incubate with gentle agitation for 30 min.

steps.title: Store plugs
steps.instruction: Submerge the plugs in TE and store at 4 °C.
